# Test fixtures

Small PDFs written by real software, so the tests do not only check the
analyzer against files built by its own test code.

| File | Written by |
|---|---|
| `reportlab.pdf`, `fpdf2.pdf`, `pillow_image.pdf` | ReportLab, fpdf2, Pillow |
| `chrome_headless.pdf` | Google Chrome, headless print to PDF |
| `macos_quartz.pdf` | macOS print pipeline (`cupsfilter`) |
| `qpdf_linearized.pdf`, `qpdf_objstm.pdf` | qpdf, from `reportlab.pdf` |
| `qpdf_rc4_128.pdf`, `qpdf_aes128.pdf`, `qpdf_aes256.pdf` | qpdf encryption, owner password only |
| `qpdf_aes256_userpw.pdf` | qpdf encryption, user password `secret` |
| `mutool_incremental.pdf` | MuPDF incremental save on top of `reportlab.pdf` |
| `linearized_then_updated.pdf` | MuPDF incremental save on top of `qpdf_linearized.pdf` |

All of the above are regenerated by `tests/make_fixtures.py`.

## Third-party files

`bfo_pdfa2-6-1-13-t10-fail.pdf` and `bfo_pdfa2-6-1-13-t11-fail.pdf` are
unmodified copies of `pdfa2-6-1-13-bfo-t10-fail.pdf` and
`pdfa2-6-1-13-bfo-t11-fail.pdf` from the BFO PDF/A test suite,
https://github.com/bfocom/pdfa-testsuite, licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode).
They contain a name that is not valid UTF-8, as a dictionary key (t10) and as
a value (t11): input that once crashed the analyzer.

`pdfa_org_PDF-versions1.pdf`, `pdfa_org_PDF-versions2.pdf` and
`pdfa_org_UnknownFilter-PageContentStream.pdf` are unmodified copies of
`PDF-version/PDF-versions1.pdf`, `PDF-version/PDF-versions2.pdf` and
`UnknownFilter/UnknownFilter-PageContentStream.pdf` from the PDF Association's
pdf-differences repository, https://github.com/pdf-association/pdf-differences,
licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The first two must be reported as
PDF 1.6 (header 1.4, catalog 1.5, an update to 1.6); the third declares the
unpublished version 3.3 and a filter, `/XXXDecode`, that does not exist.
